DECISION: Remove the dropdown’s opening animation; use a short, subtle exit from the trigger edge. Delay pointer tooltips while keeping keyboard tooltips instant. No new abstraction or dependency.
FIX: Replace `transition: all 400ms ease-in` with `.menu { transform-origin: top right; opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; } .menu[data-closing] { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 120ms ease-in; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .menu[data-closing] { transform: scale(.98); filter: blur(4px); transition: opacity 120ms ease-in, transform 120ms ease-in, filter 120ms ease-in; } }` (use `top left` if aligned to the trigger’s left edge). In the existing menu handlers, show immediately on open; on close set `data-closing`, then hide after the opacity `transitionend`; cancel pending close cleanup and remove `data-closing` if reopened mid-exit. For the tooltip, schedule pointer opening after 900ms only when `(hover: hover)` matches; cancel on pointer leave. Show immediately on keyboard focus via `:focus-visible`; keep it open while the trigger or tooltip is hovered or keyboard focus remains. Close on Escape and suppress reopening until that hover/focus session ends. Link the tooltip with `aria-describedby`, give it `role="tooltip"`, and hide it while the menu is open. Keep the trigger a named `<button type="button">` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and synchronized `aria-expanded`; preserve menu keyboard navigation and restore trigger focus on Escape.
VERIFICATION: Not verified: no files edited and no runnable surface or browser supplied. Check immediate opening, 120ms exit, rapid reopening without stale cleanup, reduced-motion opacity-only exit, 900ms pointer delay, instant keyboard-focus tooltip, pointer travel onto the tooltip, Escape dismissal, and touch behavior.
QUESTION: no

DECISION: Use a 16px card radius, shadow-only elevation, and a subtle inset image outline.
FIX: .pricing-card { border-radius: 16px; padding: 8px; border: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.15); } .pricing-card img { border-radius: 8px; outline: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); outline-offset: -1px; }
VERIFICATION: Not verified in a browser; no runnable surface provided. No files edited.
QUESTION: no

DECISION: Use a short, targeted ease-out transition anchored to the trigger; delay hover tooltips while keeping keyboard-focus help immediate.
FIX: Replace `transition: all 400ms ease-in` with `.menu { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.98); transform-origin: top right; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .menu[data-open="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); pointer-events: auto; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .menu { transition: none; transform: none; } }` (use the corner nearest the trigger). Keep the closed menu `hidden` or `inert` so its items cannot receive focus. In JS, schedule hover tooltips with a cancellable 600ms timer; cancel and hide on pointerleave, blur, click, Escape, or menu opening. Show immediately on `:focus-visible`, not pointer-induced focus; suppress tooltips while the menu is open. Preserve an accessible button name, `aria-expanded`, and menu keyboard handling.
VERIFICATION: Not run—no files edited or executable UI provided. Check that opening animates only opacity/transform for 120ms from the trigger corner, brief hover shows no tooltip, sustained hover does, keyboard focus shows help immediately, opening dismisses it, closed items cannot receive focus, and reduced-motion disables animation.
QUESTION: no

DECISION: Use a restrained card surface and give the white image a visible edge; its radius should account for the inset.
FIX: .pricing-card { border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #fff; box-shadow: none; } .pricing-card img { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; }
